text: I was so happy at the beginning. Yeah, it was a bit expensive, but I got so much joy and inspiration. Then more and more bugs were found during the year I used it. I planned to cancel the subscription and I thought I managed to do this but they tricked me. Trial there, trial here, subscription on their site instead of google stor and finally I was charged 40$ for another year. I hope they will spend ppls money for improving the app itself. The support doesn't reply to my emails.
author: Anna Rogovets
developer_reply: Hi Anna! Thanks for the feedback. Sorry for any misunderstandings. We make sure to state that the free trial or subscription can be managed at any time and provide the steps for cancellation at the time of signing up and in our FAQ which is accessible in-app and on our website. Please reach out to our support team if you have any further feedback.
